name: template-language
body:
Template language: layouts (`layout.html.tmpl`) are standard Go html/template only — no third-party template engine, no Sprig.
- Content arrives pre-rendered: the body, `text` fields (inline Markdown) and each named section (rendered through its section template) are passed as safe HTML. Other fields are passed as typed values: number/date already formatted per their `_format`, boolean, enum, list, image/link URLs.
- Layouts never parse or render Markdown; there is no markdown helper.
- The custom function set is minimal and centrally defined and documented. v1 has exactly one helper: `media "path"`, whose argument is a path relative to `templates/media/` only (e.g. `{{media "logo.svg"}}` → `templates/media/logo.svg`), returning that file's served URL. The argument must not be absolute and must not contain `..` segments; a missing file, an absolute path or a `..` segment is a templates error qualified with the layout's file:line. `media` never resolves into `themes/`: theme-owned files (fonts, logos in `themes/<name>/`) are referenced only from that theme's `theme.css` via relative `url()` and are served from the theme directory. Adding a helper is a spec change.
- Every layout and every section template is additionally executed with a reserved deck/slide data context (see template-context): `deck` carries the deck-wide `title`, `author`, `date` and the author's `properties`; `slide` carries the derived position label `number` (a string: the slide's number, plus its letter for a vertical slide) and the integer `total`. This context is data, not a helper — the v1 function set stays exactly `media` — and `deck`/`slide` are reserved top-level names.
- Layouts have no file, environment or network access.
- Layout parse and execute errors are file:line-qualified templates errors (parse at templates-dir-validation step 3; `media` arguments checked at step 6; execute errors during example/deck render reported as templates errors).
AC: a layout using any function other than the documented set fails to parse with a file:line templates error; a layout referencing `{{media "logo.svg"}}` with `templates/media/logo.svg` present renders its served URL; `{{media "missing.svg"}}`, `{{media "../x"}}` and `{{media "/abs"}}` each yield a templates error naming the layout file:line; body/text/section values render unescaped as HTML while other string values are auto-escaped; a layout or section template can read `{{.deck.title}}`, a property via `{{index .deck.properties "<key>"}}` and the string `{{.slide.number}}`/integer `{{.slide.total}}`.
